causalWitnesses.interpretation: Both pitches exist in the sealed production decoded publication. The research-only fixed 35ms acoustic gesture assembler splits their estimated times, although the fixed MIDI GT grouping contains one chord. This is not proof that Robust failed to detect G#4, nor a defect in deterministic physical MIDI 35ms grouping. The frozen decoded-to-gesture recipe is insufficient for this product safety case. No wider window was tried.

The complete physical GT chord contains an extra B2, absent from the sealed owned decoded observations near the attack. B2 is only 3.33ms after owned start. Since non-owned decoder outputs were not sealed, these artifacts do not distinguish model non-detection from a peak assigned before the owned boundary. This is a scoped published-evidence failure witness, not an attribution to neural model accuracy. Safety already fails on the independent non-edge Bach case.
